items.title: Overview of International Frameworks (e.g., GDPR) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Overview of International Frameworks (e.g., GDPR) (PDF 136, printed 132).

blocks.text: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) European Union ka qanoon hai jo zaati data ki hifazat karta hai. Yeh qawaid tay karta hai ke idare data kaise jama, store aur use karein. GDPR transparency (shaffafiyat), consent (ijazat) aur zaati maloomat dekhne ya delete karwane ka haq lazmi karta hai. Bohat se mulk aur companies duniya bhar mein data privacy ke liye isi jaise miyar apnati hain. In frameworks ka maqsad zaati maloomat ke ghalat istemal ko rokna aur accountability (jawab-dehi) barhana hai.

blocks.prompt: GDPR kis ka qanoon hai aur yeh users ko kaun se teen huqooq ya usool deta hai?
blocks.explanation: European Union ka. Transparency (batana ke data kaise use hota hai), consent (ijazat) aur zaati maloomat dekhne ya delete karwane ka haq.

items: GDPR: EU ka data protection qanoon; transparency, consent, access ya delete ka haq.
Duniya bhar mein milte julte standards.
